value:
RE-CENSUS OF THE ADDR16_LO HOME-COPY CLASS AT HEAD c0f978273, WITH A NEW APPARATUS AND FIVE NEW DISCRIMINANTS MEASURED BOTH WAYS. Five findings.

FINDING 1 - THE APPARATUS. Both sides were read as ELF OBJECTS with one objdump parser and one regex set: the dtk target split under build/GUNE5D/obj/** carries FULL R_PPC_ADDR16_HA / ADDR16_LO relocations, so the .s-text parsing every earlier census in this family used (addr16_census.py, addrlo_home_general_census.py, addrlo_inplace_census.py, addrlo_shadow_probe.py, addr16_homing_census.py) was never necessary, and the hex-vs-decimal immediate hazard those tools each carry a warning about (claim.law.target-asm-hex-immediates-bias-any-hand-rolled-census.20260901.v1) cannot arise at all in the object-to-object form. Any future census in this family should join objects, not text. 257 units, 3025 paired functions, 2160 of them BYTE-EXACT by `fndiff.parse(target) == fndiff.parse(ours)`.

FINDING 2 - THE PUBLISHED CS-ONLY CENSUS REPRODUCES EXACTLY, FOUR DAYS AND MANY COMMITS LATER, AND S=0 SURVIVES WITHIN ITS OWN SCOPE. With the destination restricted to callee-saved, as addrlo_home_general_census.py restricts it: P=40 Q=24 S=0 over 953 opportunities -- the published figures to the unit. GENERALISING THE HOME DESTINATION TO INCLUDE VOLATILE REGISTERS (the variant EN's run-51 records name for move_logic22): P=45 Q=48 S=1 over 986 opportunities. S IS NOT ZERO. The instance is game/mb/mb_particle::setupNewPMode_800CDCE4, target 8 paid copies against our 4, and it is a genuine inversion at instance level: at the getNewDirSingle1 / getNewDirFrame / getNewDirConeUnique / getNewDirConeShare sites the TARGET routes the low half through r6 and copies into r4 while OUR build forms the address in r4 directly. CONSEQUENCE, and it is the actionable one: the strict one-directionality that both parent laws use to argue allocator-internal causation is a property of the CALLEE-SAVED class only. It does NOT extend to the volatile-home variant, so attempt.EN_movelogic22-is-the-volatile-home-variant-of-the-addr16-lo-copy-class.20260904.v1 inherits a disposition from a law whose decisive premise does not cover its function. move_logic22 is not screened out by S=0; a lane may legitimately re-probe it on a form other than the for-init reorder that record already capped.

FINDING 3 - THE CLASS IS TWO MECHANISMS, NOT ONE, AND THE CORPUS TREATS IT AS ONE. Of our 75 shape-B instances, 29 have the @lo addi INSIDE the prologue shadow and 46 have it after the frame setup; per function that is 21 shadow-class and 19-24 body-class. Per-instance pairing of the 40 paired P sites (target's shape-A gap against our shape-B gap, where gap = distance from the @ha `lis` to the @lo `addi`): target gap > ours in 21, equal in 13, smaller in 6, 10 unpairable. THE 21 ARE EXACTLY THE SHADOW SUBCLASS AND THEIR SIGNATURE IS UNIFORM: the target's prologue shadow is 3 instructions (mflr, lis, stw) and ours is 4 or 5, our gap is 2 in nineteen of the twenty-one, and the target's is 4 to 7. The two subclasses need different levers and only the shadow one has ever been described; see claim.law.AL_the-addrlo-home-copy-survives-scheduling-off-so-the-prologue-shadow-is-a-symptom.20260904.v1 for the experiment that closes the shadow one.

FINDING 4 - FIVE NEW DISCRIMINANTS, EACH MEASURED ON BOTH SIDES AND ON THE BYTE-EXACT CORPUS. NONE of these is among AD's twelve. (D13) OUR BUILD CANNOT SPLIT AN @ha/@lo PAIR ACROSS THE FRAME SETUP -- REFUTED, and it is not close: `lis` in the shadow with the `addi` after it numbers 442 on the target and 429 on ours image-wide, 367 vs 351 of them shape A, and 174 in byte-exact functions where our compiler emits the target's exact split form from proven-correct source. (D14) @ha TEMP REGISTER IDENTITY (AD's axis 7 was the HOME register, never the temp) -- REFUTED: byte-exact shape A r3:177/332 = 53.3%, shape B r3:8/14 = 57%. (D15) @ha->@lo GAP (AD's axis 11 was the gap BETWEEN formations, never inside one) -- ONE-SIDED INVARIANT, NOT A DISCRIMINANT: restricted to byte-exact sites whose lis is after the frame, ALL 7 shape-B sites have gap exactly 1 while shape A is adjacent in only 75 of 158 (47.5%, mean 2.57), so B implies gap 1 but gap 1 predicts nothing. (D17) @ha TEMP REUSE COUNT -- REFUTED. (D21) PROLOGUE-SHADOW OCCUPANCY -- ONE-SIDED INVARIANT: shape B with the lis in the shadow occurs only at shadow size 4 or 5, never 3 (target 0 of 173, byte-exact 0 of 90), and every P-shadow target has shadow 3 while ours has 4 or 5; but shape A occurs freely at shadow 4 and 5 (79 byte-exact instances), so a large shadow does not force the copy either.

FINDING 5 - THE METHODOLOGICAL RESULT, WHICH GENERALISES BEYOND THIS CLASS. D14 and D17 BOTH show an apparent separation on the whole 3025-function image and a flat NULL on the 2160 byte-exact functions: D17 reads 2.02 (shape A) vs 2.82 (shape B) image-wide and 1.54 vs 1.50 byte-exact. An image-wide contrast in this family mixes functions whose source is wrong everywhere else with functions whose source is right, and manufactures separations that vanish under the byte-exact restriction. RESTRICT ANY CODEGEN-DISCRIMINANT CONTRAST TO BYTE-EXACT FUNCTIONS BEFORE BELIEVING IT; the byte-exact corpus is the control, and it is free.
